cv:
Daniela Ríos · NLP engineer · Cali, Colombia
Customer-support SaaS (2021 – present, 5 years): ticket summarization, self-hosted models.
reply:
Hi Sofia,

1. I built ticket summarization for our support SaaS: every closed ticket gets a three-line summary that managers read in their weekly review. It covers about 40,000 tickets a month, and I owned the model serving and the prompts.
2. Managers rated 300 summaries as useful or not; we started at 78% useful and reached 90%, and we re-run that set on every change.
3. Some customers forbade sending data to external APIs, so I deployed Mistral 7B and Llama 3.1 8B on our own servers and compared them with the hosted model on the same 300 tickets; Llama 3.1 8B was close enough for those customers at a much lower cost.
4. Customer names and ticket IDs are masked in code before summarization and restored afterwards; the model never sees them.
5. Cali, Colombia. $30–38/h. English 8/10. 7 hours of overlap.

Best,
Daniela
